title: fix(grid): in a list cell a single click only selects; no copy buttons (#36015)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2yMB8uuX9RDZCxYnGyuHiY)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTQn1haiL13TBfwmxm

Refs #36015

The card's scope changed after this PR was opened (maintainer, 2026-11-21 11:13Z: lookup chips open the referenced record in the side drawer on a single click, with a pencil button on lookup cells). This PR lands everything the revision kept. The lookup-cell part follows in its own PR, which carries `Fixes #36015`. Until then, a lookup chip selects its cell on a single click and opens with Ctrl/Cmd-click, the open button or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表格子里单击只做一件事：选中这一格。点邮箱、电话、网址、文件、关联记录或人员的小标签、图片缩略图，都只是选中，不再打开邮件程序、拨号、网页或跳到别的记录。
- 想打开时有三条路：按住 Ctrl / Cmd 再点；选中这一格后鼠标移上去，格子右边出现「打开」小图标，点它；或选中后按 Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter。一格里有多个标签时，图标和快捷键打开第一个。
- 邮箱、电话格里的复制按钮在列表里不再出现；复制用选中后 Ctrl+C / Cmd+C。双击邮箱文字照常进入编辑。
- 名称列不变：单击名称进记录页。记录页、相关列表、手机卡片、看板卡片都不变（它们没有「先选中」的格子模型）。
- 风险：改了 data-table、字段格子渲染和名称列链接三处；没有新导出、没有新文案键（「打开」复用已有的 `table.open`）。

## What changes

The rule, on a grid with the select-first cell model (`GridCellSelectionProvider`, mounted by `ObjectGrid` when its host passes `cellSelection`; today the console's list page): **a single click on a cell only selects it.**

**`@object-ui/components`: `dataTableCellSelection.ts`, `data-table.tsx`**

- New `cellOpenerAt` / `firstCellOpener`: a cell's *opener* is any `a[href]` it draws, except one marked `data-opens-on-click`, plus any element marked `data-cell-opener`.
- `isCellWidgetTarget` no longer counts an opener as a widget. A press on a link is a press on the cell, so a double-click on the email text edits, and the double-click's word selection is suppressed as on any cell.
- Each select-first cell gets an `onClickCapture`. A plain primary click on an opener calls `preventDefault` (no `mailto:`, `tel:`, new tab or download), stops the event before the opener's own handler (no SPA navigation), and selects the cell. A Ctrl, Cmd, Shift or Alt click, a non-primary button, a touch tap and a click inside an open editor pass through unchanged.
- The selected cell draws `CellOpenButton`, an icon button at its right edge labelled with the existing `table.open` key. It is shown on cell hover (`group-hover/cell`) and drawn only while the cell holds an opener; a `MutationObserver` catches a lookup chip that becomes a link after its name is read. It takes no focus (`tabIndex=-1`, `mousedown` prevented), so typing carries on in the cell. It never appears on an unselected cell or on row hover.
- Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on the selected cell (the type catcher) opens the cell's first opener; with no opener the key does nothing. Plain Enter still edits.
- Opening means clicking the opener for the reader (`openCellOpener`) while a ref tells the capture handler to let it through. Each value keeps its own behaviour: the host's `openRecord` for a referenced record, the browser's for `mailto:` / `tel:` / `target=_blank`, the lightbox for an image.
- Select-first cells carry `[&_[data-cell-copy]]:hidden`, so a copy control a value draws is not drawn there. Ctrl/Cmd+C on the selected cell copies, as before.

**`@object-ui/fields`: `index.tsx`**

- The email and phone copy buttons carry `data-cell-copy`. These are the only copy buttons a cell renderer draws (searched `clipboard.writeText` and the `Copy` icon across `fields`, `plugin-grid`, `components` renderers and `react`; the other hits are edit widgets or grid-level hooks).
- Image thumbnails (single, stacked, and the `+N` button) carry `data-cell-opener`.

**`@object-ui/plugin-grid`: `objectGridLinkCell.tsx`**

- The name column's record link (`RecordLink` anchor) carries `data-opens-on-click`. It is the one link a single click still follows (card item 5). Its span fallback (no host URL) is `role="link"`, which stays a widget and keeps its click.

**Field types this reaches in a list cell:** email, phone, url, file / video / audio (download link), image (thumbnail lightbox), restricted file (lock link), lookup / master_detail / tree and every other reference family drawn through `ReferencedRecordLink` (owner and other user lookups included), and any custom cell renderer that draws an `a[href]`.

**Not changed (claim readings A–C):**

- **A.** Only grids with the select-first model. Related lists, the record page's fields, phone cards (`ObjectGrid` below 768px), kanban cards, and every grid whose host does not pass `cellSelection` keep their links and copy buttons byte for byte. The copy buttons are hidden by the table, not removed by the renderer, for exactly this reason: the phone card under the same provider still draws them.
- **B.** A cell of several chips opens the first one by the button or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter; a Ctrl/Cmd-click opens the one clicked.
- **C.** File links and image thumbnails follow the same rule.

Docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` § On an object's list page (the click bullet and the selected-cell keys).

## Tests

Rewritten, because it pinned the behaviour this card reverses:

- `components/src/__tests__/data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx`: the describe "a link in a cell keeps its click" ("a click on the link follows it and selects nothing; a double-click beside it edits") is replaced by "a click on a link the cell draws only selects (objectstack#36015)". It pins: a plain click selects and cancels the default, Ctrl/Cmd-click follows, a double-click on the link edits, the `data-opens-on-click` title link keeps its click (control), the open button appears only on the selected cell and follows the link, a cell with nothing to open hides the button, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter follows the link while plain Enter edits, and the copy-hiding class is present only under the provider (control without it). The fixture's link cell gained a `data-cell-copy` button; an opt-in `withTitle` column carries the title link.

Added:

- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, new describe, end to end through `ObjectGrid` with a host that routes records: a click on the `mailto:` link and on the lookup chip selects each cell, cancels the default and opens nothing; Ctrl+Enter and the open button call the host's `openRecord` for the referenced record; the title link is the only `data-opens-on-click` element and keeps its click; the email cell draws its copy button marked `data-cell-copy` inside a cell that hides it.

Unchanged and still green: `ObjectGrid.linkCellNoNestedAnchor-11817.test.tsx` ("an email column that is not the link column keeps its mailto anchor and copy button", a grid without `cellSelection`, the control for reading A), `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596.test.tsx`, `data-table-keys-35687`, `data-table-cell-overlay-35688`, `data-table-autosave-35685`.

Local runs (`@objectstack/*` built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`; first on `be91bfc2`, the data-table / ObjectGrid / fields files again after merging `c00be39b`, which carries #36018 and #36021):

- `vitest run packages/components/ packages/fields/ packages/plugin-grid/`: 1103 files passed. The only failing file is `share-filter-sort-spec-parity.test.ts`, which reads `@objectstack/spec`'s `.d.ts` that a DTS-less build does not write.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-list/`: 180 files passed. The only failing file is `spec-symbol-batch6.test.tsx`, for the same reason.
- After the merge: `vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/` plus `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684`, `ObjectGrid.linkCellNoNestedAnchor-11817`, `selectionBar-35678` and `inCellFaces-35688`: 289 files passed; the same parity file failed, and `object-icon-tile-35985` failed against a stale spec build and passed once the spec was rebuilt.
- `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `overlap-check` on the pushed head: clean against `origin/main`, no open PR shares a file.

## Verification (browser)

CRM example (`--fresh`), Console via Vite HMR on this tree, Chromium. The before run used `origin/main`'s versions of the four source files. Screenshots and journey logs: project folder `build-seat1/36015/` (`before-*`, `after-*`).

| Step (Contacts list, 1280) | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Hover a row | copy icon beside each email | no copy icon |
| Click the email text | `mailto:` request, cell not selected | cell selected, navigation cancelled |
| Click the Account chip | page leaves for the account record | cell selected, page stays |
| Selected chip cell, hover | no open button | open button at the right edge |
| Ctrl+Enter on it | nothing | opens the account record |
| Click the name | opens the contact record | same |
| Double-click the email text | `mailto:` twice, no editor | editor opens |
| Accounts list, click the Website link | new tab opened | cell selected, no tab |
| 375 phone list | cards | same cards |

## Acceptance notes

1. Hover a row: no copy icon in the email or phone cell: yes (browser, email; phone shares the same marker and class, unit-pinned through the fixture).
2. Click the email text: the cell is selected, no mail program; Ctrl/Cmd+C copies the address: yes (Ctrl+C path unchanged, `String(row[col])`).
3. Phone and URL cells: same: yes (URL in the browser; phone is an `a[href^="tel:"]`, the same opener rule).
4. Owner chip and lookup chip: selected, the page does not leave: yes (the Account lookup chip in the browser; an owner or other user lookup draws the same `ReferencedRecordLink` anchor, not checked in the browser separately).
5. Ctrl/Cmd-click email opens the mail program; Ctrl/Cmd-click a chip opens the record: yes (the click passes through untouched).
6. The open icon appears on the selected lookup cell, opens the record, and is absent when the cell is not selected: yes.
7. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter opens: yes.
8. Click the name opens the record page as before: yes.
9. Double-click the email cell edits: yes.
10. Record page email and phone fields unchanged: yes (no select-first model there; renderer markup only gains attributes).
11. This body lists the field types reached and the rewritten tests: above.
